centreAddress: Premier Business Park, 52 Broomhill Rd, Tallaght, D24 VE8E
paragraphs: From Tallaght Driving Test Centre in Premier Business Park take the 1st left to continue along Broomhill Road for about 400 metres
At the end of the road turn right onto Airton Road and follow it for roughly 460 metres
Turn left onto Belgard Road and go straight through the roundabout
Turn right onto Old Blessington Road, then take the next right into Belgard Square East
Continue around into Belgard Square North and take the roundabout 1st exit on the left
At the end of the road turn right onto Cookstown Way, then 1st left onto Maplewood Road
Practice a turnabout on the quiet unnamed road here
Turn right back onto Maplewood Road and right onto Cookstown Way
At the junction turn right onto the Tallaght Bypass, which becomes the Blessington Road straight ahead
Turn left into Killinarden Way, then 1st right into Killinarden Estate
Follow the estate around and practice another turnabout
Come back out with a right, then left, then left onto Killinarden Way
Turn left onto the Blessington Road and take the next right onto Cheeverstown Road
Turn right onto Cookstown Road and then left onto Fettercairn Road
Continue for around 300 metres and turn right onto Fettercairn Link Road
Turn right again onto Katharine Tynan Road
Take the slight left onto Cookstown Road, then 1st right into Alpine Rise
Turn left onto The Lawn and left onto The Crescent
At the end turn right onto The Rise, then right onto The Meadows East
Turn left onto The Heath, then left onto The View
Turn right onto Belgard Heights and right onto Old Belgard Road
Turn left onto Katharine Tynan Road and right onto Belgard Road
To return toward the test centre turn left onto Airton Road
Turn left onto Broomhill Road, passing the centre
Park near Premier Business Park and practice a reverse around the corner
Head back out to Belgard Road and go straight through the roundabouts
Turn right onto the Tallaght Bypass, continuing onto the Blessington Road
Turn right onto Cheeverstown Road and right onto Fettercairn Road to complete the route
